# Bill Layne Insurance Agency
> Independent insurance agency in Elkin & Dobson, NC serving all 100 North Carolina counties since 2005. Our local team compares available carrier options for coverage and value.

## About
Bill Layne Insurance Agency is an independent insurance agency founded in 2005 by Bill Layne, a licensed North Carolina insurance agent (NPN #6608086) with 20+ years of experience. As an independent agency we represent multiple carriers and compare available options based on the customer’s needs and carrier eligibility.

## Carriers We Represent
Auto insurance:
- Nationwide
- Progressive
- Travelers
- National General
- Foremost
- Dairyland

Home insurance:
- Nationwide
- Travelers
- Alamance Farmers Mutual
- NC Grange Mutual

Specialty lines:
- Hagerty (classic & collector car)
- Dairyland (motorcycle & ATV)
- Foremost (mobile & manufactured home)

## Services
- Auto Insurance (liability, comprehensive, collision, uninsured and underinsured motorist)
- Home Insurance (dwelling, personal property, liability, loss of use)
- Renters Insurance
- Motorcycle & ATV Insurance
- Boat / Pontoon / PWC Insurance
- Commercial / Business Insurance
- Flood Insurance
- Umbrella Insurance
- Classic Car Insurance (Hagerty)

- Member of IIANC (Independent Insurance Agents of NC)

## Home Insurance: Consent to Rate, Credit and Nonrenewal
- [NC Consent to Rate Explained](https://www.billlayneinsurance.com/home-insurance/consent-to-rate/) - why a North Carolina home renewal shows two prices, the 2019 no-signature rule (N.C. Gen. Stat. 58-36-30), and what to do
- [Home Insurance With Less-Than-Perfect Credit](https://www.billlayneinsurance.com/home-insurance/bad-credit-home-insurance-nc/) - NC Grange Mutual rates the house, not a credit-based insurance score, and does not use consent-to-rate pricing
- [Dropped Over a Trampoline, Pool, Dog or Outbuilding](https://www.billlayneinsurance.com/home-insurance/trampoline-pool-dog-outbuilding-nc/) - NC Grange signed exclusion forms for a trampoline, pool, dog or outbuilding; 45-day nonrenewal notice rule
- [NC Grange Mutual Home Insurance](https://www.billlayneinsurance.com/home-insurance/nc-grange-mutual/) - North Carolina-only mutual, sold through independent agents; Bill Layne Insurance is an appointed agency
